passkeys.description: A passkey lets you sign in without typing a password, using your fingerprint, face recognition or your device's screen lock. It is also used for extra verification on payments that look risky.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.addedOk: Passkey added. You can use it to sign in right away; for payment verification it becomes available after 24 hours, for your security.
passkeys.cancelled: The passkey operation was cancelled or timed out

passkeys.nameHint: Helps you tell your passkeys apart. If you leave it blank, it is shown as “{unnamed}”.
passkeys.confirmDeleteBody: Added {date}. You will no longer be able to sign in or verify payments with this passkey.
passkeys.confirmDeleteLast: This is the last passkey on your account. If you delete it, passwordless sign-in is turned off and payments that look risky will ask for your bank's 3D Secure verification instead.
passkeys.addCancelled: No passkey was added: the request was cancelled or timed out.
passkeys.deleteCancelled: Cancelled; the passkey was not deleted.

mandates.title: AI agent payment permissions
mandates.intro: You can let an AI assistant (agent) you use pay for a booking on your behalf. You decide the most it can spend, how long the permission lasts and, optionally, which listings it covers; you can revoke it at any time.
mandates.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
mandates.propertiesHint: Pick up to {max} listings from your favorites and bookings; the agent can then pay only for those. If you pick none, the permission covers every listing.
mandates.created: Permission created. Copy the permission document now; it won't be shown again.
mandates.tokenOnce: This signed permission document is shown only once. Give it to your agent; do not share it with anyone else.
mandates.scoped: {count, plural, one {Limited to # listing} other {Limited to # listings}}
mandates.revokeLabel: Revoke permission with limit {amount}, valid until {date}
mandates.revoked: Permission revoked; the agent can no longer pay with it.
mandates.createFailed: Could not create the permission. Please try again.
mandates.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the permission. Please try again.
mandates.revokeConfirmBody: The permission with a {amount} limit, valid until {date}, will be revoked. Your agent will no longer be able to pay with it and this cannot be undone; you would need to grant a new permission.

rules.singleUse: Each permission can be used for one booking payment only; for another booking, grant a new permission.
rules.perBooking: The amount you enter is the cap for that single payment; a booking that costs more is declined.
rules.currency: The currency must match the currency the listing is priced in; otherwise the payment is declined.

howSteps.choose: Below, choose the most the agent can spend on one booking, how long the permission lasts and, optionally, the listings.
howSteps.copy: Grant the permission and copy the permission document, which is shown only once.
howSteps.share: Paste the document only into the AI assistant you use. Once the agent pays, the permission shows as “Used” in the list; you can revoke it here if needed.

mandates.currencyHint: Must match the listing's price currency.
mandates.currencyMismatch: Some of the selected listings are priced in {currencies}; choose that currency or untick those listings.
mandates.propertiesNone: You have no listings in your favorites or bookings yet. You can add one by pasting its page link below.
mandates.propertiesMax: You can select up to {max} listings.
mandates.propertyLinkHint: Paste the address of the listing page (e.g. …/property/abc123).
mandates.propertyLinkInvalid: This doesn't look like a listing link. Paste the listing page address.
mandates.propertyNotFound: No listing was found for this link.
mandates.propertyLookupFailed: Could not check the listing. Please try again.
mandates.summary: Summary: your agent will be able to pay up to {amount} for a single booking, valid for {duration} ({scope}).
mandates.summaryScopeSome: {count, plural, one {only the # selected listing} other {only the # selected listings}}
mandates.summaryEmpty: Enter an amount to see a summary of the permission.
mandates.copied: Permission document copied to the clipboard.
mandates.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically. The text is selected; press Ctrl+C (⌘+C on Mac) or long-press and choose Copy.
mandates.replaceTokenBody: You haven't copied the permission document shown on screen yet. If you grant a new permission, this document is removed from the screen and can't be shown again; the earlier permission stays in the list and you can revoke it if needed.
mandates.statusUsed: Used — not valid for new payments
